lines: Hi, I'm Priya Raman (priya.raman@example.com). Since September 2020 I've been a Customer Success Manager at Lumenly Software. I run quarterly business reviews with 40 enterprise accounts, I collect product feedback from customers and present it to the product team, and I wrote onboarding documentation for new customers. I raised customer retention from 82% to 91% and reduced onboarding time from 6 weeks to 3 weeks.

Before that, from May 2017 to August 2020, I was a Support Agent at Orbit Telecom, where I resolved customer billing and connectivity issues by phone and chat and maintained a customer satisfaction score of 96%.
I studied Business Management (BA) at the University of Leeds from 2013 to 2017. I work with Salesforce, SQL and Jira, and I do a lot of customer interviews.
